name: Code de la commande publique — Public Procurement
standard: Code de la commande publique (CCP, Ordonnance 2018-1074)
description: Validates public tender documents against the Code de la commande publique (effective 2019-04-01). Checks AAPC publication requirements, CCAG-Travaux references, allotissement (lot splitting) obligations, selection criteria documentation, threshold compliance (European and national), avance forfaitaire, and sous-traitance (subcontracting) declaration requirements.
planned_not_built_note: Planned, not built. The engine defines none of the ids in planned_not_built_rule_ids, so switching this document on does not run them. They record what this document is meant to check once the rules are written; move an id back to enables_rule_ids on the day its rule lands, not before.
regulator: Direction des Affaires Juridiques (DAJ), Ministere de l'Economie
